## Services and Typical Pricing

We believe in transparent pricing. These are typical ranges — every yard is different, so request a free quote for your exact price.

### Fencing

- Vinyl fence installation: **$35 per linear foot or better** for white vinyl (tan also available)
- Gates: around **$400 per gate** (custom built, galvanized steel frame, hardware included)
- We beat most competitors on price for comparable vinyl fence work.

### Sod

- Fresh-cut Kentucky Bluegrass, locally grown in Utah
- Best sod prices in town
- Priced by square footage — request a free quote for your exact price

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do you work on new-construction homes?**
Yes — new builds are our specialty. We handle the full yard: fence, sod, turf, and sprinklers.

**Which areas do you serve?**
Eagle Mountain, Saratoga Springs, Lehi, American Fork, and nearby Utah County communities.

**How do I get a quote?**
Call or text (801) 750-6820, or request a free quote at https://vantagelandscapingllc.com/

**Can I get fence and sod done together?**
Yes — bundling multiple services with one contractor is simpler and often more cost-effective than hiring separate crews.
